name: Ledger Line
site_type: One-page firm site with an animated month-end hero and a book-a-call form
features: one-page site: hero, how it works, services, numbers, why, founder note and FAQ, book a call
hero with three panels that play once: receipts settle, a month-end checklist ticks itself off, a profit and loss counts up and always adds up
checklist lines and profit and loss figures edited in the block sidebar; gross and net profit are calculated
how-it-works line that fills as you scroll, each step lights up
service cards with small moving graphics: transactions getting categories, US estimated tax dates, a cash-flow line
number band that counts up; words of the Why paragraph go from faint to ink as you read
founder note with a signature that writes itself in
FAQ with WordPress's own Details block: keyboard and no-JavaScript friendly
book-a-call form with plain-English errors, demo only: nothing is sent and the form says so
three small custom blocks in a plugin (hero panels, service graphic, book form), everything else native blocks
meta descriptions and Open Graph tags
block theme, native blocks, block patterns, no page builder
